name: Attribuly
summary: Recovers abandoned carts Klaviyo misses — identifies visitors, syncs intent signals back into Klaviyo and lets an AI agent send a personalised recovery email.
best_for: stores already running Klaviyo or Omnisend at volume, with enough traffic for identity resolution to work and a recovery figure they can check against their own email platform before a 10% share of it becomes the bill
skip_if: you do not run Klaviyo or another supported email platform, since the product feeds them rather than replacing them; or you need a fixed monthly bill, because the recovery plan is now 10% of what it recovers with a $100 floor
honest_knock: The pricing has moved within two months. In August and September 2026 the listing went from free straight to $450 or $500 a month; on 14 October 2026 the recovery plan, ReCapture, had become a $100 monthly minimum plus 10% of the incremental revenue it recovers, while Capture stayed at $450 flat. The new shape lowers the entry cost but ties the bill to a figure Attribuly itself measures, so ask how 'incremental' is deduplicated against your existing Klaviyo flows before the trial ends. It is still an add-on rather than a replacement: the pitch is explicitly that it recovers carts “Klaviyo misses” and syncs identity signals back into Klaviyo, so you pay for this on top of an email platform you already pay for.

pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-10-14 on apps.shopify.com/attribuly and attribuly.com/pricing-retention/; the plan ladder changed after 13 September 2026) A free plan that recovers the first $1,000 of email revenue for free, then two paid plans, each with a 7-day free trial (it was 14 days in September). ReCapture is now $100 a month plus a 10% revenue share: the vendor's pricing page sets the monthly fee at the larger of $100 or 10% of the incremental revenue ReCapture recovers, and for an annual GMV of $12,000,000 or more the minimum, the rate and the other terms are agreed in a quote. Capture stays at $450 a month flat. The flat $500 Recapture plan we read in August and September 2026 is no longer on either page. All charges in USD; recurring and usage-based charges are billed every 30 days. Note the shape: the free tier is metered on recovered revenue, and the paid recovery plan is now metered the same way, so the bill moves with what it recovers. The listing's rating stood at 4.8 from 167 reviews on 14 October 2026, with 77% five-star and 7% one-star. attribuly.com/pricing also sells the vendor's own credit-based web plans, a Pro plan at $8 a month billed annually ($99) and an Enterprise plan listed at $1,000 a month with custom pricing; neither appears on the Shopify listing.
